responsibility: Declarative inventory of ARC target builtins and their expansion metadata. Each DEF_BUILTIN entry names the user-visible __builtin_arc_* interface, argument count and type signature, associated insn/expander or special-case handling, and the target feature predicate controlling availability; the table covers core control builtins, norm/swap/divaw helpers, SIMD intrinsics, and ARCv2 DSP/SIMD accumulator operations.
